narrative: 树林是白色的，天空近乎全黑。
人脸以一种安静的方式显得不对：血管、粉底、织物染料全都被重写，但这个地方依然是地球。
这不是肉眼所拥有的那个光谱。当一片风景需要在不离开实际取景地的情况下呈现出“另一个星球”的感觉时使用它：一片禁忌森林、一场红外风格的演唱会画面、一张不是绿色像增强夜视的监控静帧。
对于在完全黑暗中狩猎的场景（那是图像增强夜视），或者观察体温的场景（那是热成像），这就用错了工具。如果画面是绿色、带有噪点、灯具泛光晕开，你拍的是夜视。
如果人脸变成了铁红色调的面具，你拍的是热成像。
how: 使用红外通过滤镜和对近红外敏感的传感器或胶片，或者拆掉摄影机的红外截止滤镜。光源依然是反射的日光或富含红外的钨丝灯光，而不是发射的热量。
按照“伍德效应”（Wood effect）为树叶曝光。提示词：pale foliage, dark sky, waxy skin, near-infrared photograph, not green phosphor, not a thermal palette。
when: 一名骑手立于山脊之上，树木变得如粉笔般苍白，天空全黑，皮肤略带一种不似人间的质感，但整体依然清楚是一处日光下的风景。不要把它渲染成捕食者式的热成像色彩，也不要做成绿色护目镜画面。
vs: 夜视（Night Vision）把残留的光子增强并投射到荧光屏上，通常是绿色且带颗粒感，是一种狩猎或监控用的眼睛；热成像（Thermal）把发射出的长波辐射映射为假色调色板。
单色（Monochrome）是可见光下的黑白画面；红外摄影也可以印成单色，但它的色调关系（白色树叶、黑色天空）来自红外反射率，而不是可见光。
examples_film: 《灵异村》（The Village）在森林场景中使用红外胶片，让森林读起来像另一个世界，同时依然是一处被实拍的地点。红外演唱会摄影是它在现场音乐领域的表亲：苍白的皮肤、变暗的服装染料，没有绿色像增强管。
mistakes: 错误的近亲：夜视或热成像。破绽：绿色荧光屏颗粒、铁红色调的热量面具，或者只是普通黑白画面里正常发黑的树木。
解决办法：反转树叶与天空的明暗关系，保持它是一张反射光静帧，不要加护目镜式的HUD。

faq.q: 电影中的红外摄影是什么？
faq.a: 用近红外光进行的摄影。树叶常常变得苍白，天空变暗，皮肤和染料的色调发生偏移。这是反射率的呈现，而不是热成像摄影机。

faq.q: 红外摄影 vs 夜视
faq.a: 红外胶片或红外摄影是这个世界在特定光谱下的静态影像；夜视则是一种图像增强器：把残留的光放大并投射到荧光屏上，通常呈绿色且带颗粒感。

faq.q: 什么时候应该使用红外摄影？
faq.a: 当一片真实的风景需要在光谱意义上显得异样时使用它：苍白的树林、漆黑的天空。不要把它用于护目镜主观视角或热量探测。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写红外摄影的提示词？
faq.a: 要求苍白的树叶、漆黑的天空、蜡质般的皮肤、近红外静帧效果，并明确禁止绿色像增强管和热成像配色。

narrative: The woods are white. The sky is near black.
Faces are wrong in a quiet way: veins, powder, fabric dyes all rewrite. The place is still Earth.

The spectrum is not the one the eye owns. Use it when a landscape should feel like another planet without leaving the location: a forbidden forest, a concert IR look, a surveillance still that is not green-tube night vision.
It is the wrong tool for hunting in total dark (that is image intensification) or for seeing body heat (that is thermal). If the image is green and noisy with blooming lamps, you have night vision.
If faces are ironbow masks, you have thermal.
how: Use an IR-pass filter and a sensor or stock sensitive to near-IR, or remove a camera's IR-cut filter. Light is still reflected sunlight or IR-rich tungsten, not emitted heat.
Expose for the Wood effect on leaves. Prompt: pale foliage, dark sky, waxy skin, near-infrared photograph, not green phosphor, not a thermal palette.
when: A rider on a ridge, trees gone chalky, sky black, skin slightly unearthly, still clearly a daylight landscape. Do not render it as predator heat colors or as a green goggle feed.
vs: Night Vision intensifies residual photons onto a phosphor, usually green and grainy, as a hunting or surveillance eye. Thermal maps emitted long-wave radiation to a false-color palette.
Monochrome is visible-light black and white. Infrared can be printed mono, but its tonalities (white leaves, black sky) come from IR reflectance.
examples_film: The Village used infrared film in the woods so the forest would read as another world while remaining a photographed place. Concert IR photography is the live-music cousin: pale skin, dark clothing dyes, no green tube.
mistakes: Wrong cousin: night vision or thermal. Tell: green phosphor grain, or ironbow heat masks, or ordinary black and white with normal dark trees.
Fix: invert the foliage and sky relationship, keep it a reflected-light still, no goggle HUD.

faq.a: Photography with near-infrared light. Leaves often go pale, skies darken, skin and dyes shift. It is reflectance, not a heat camera.
Infrared film or IR photography is a spectral still of the world. Night vision is an image intensifier: residual light amplified onto a phosphor, typically green and grainy.
When a real landscape should look spectrally alien: pale woods, black sky. Do not use it for goggle POV or heat detection.

faq.q: How do I prompt infrared for AI image or video?
faq.a: Ask for pale foliage, dark skies, waxy skin, near-infrared still. Explicitly forbid green phosphor and thermal color palettes.
